boundaries.constitutional_authority: observe active canonical position state and produce monitoring observations, anomaly records, and monitoring evidence
boundaries.dependency_direction: Monitoring -> Position Registry for active position reads
boundaries.monitoring_authority: Monitoring observes lifecycle, quantity, cost basis, health, and anomaly conditions
boundaries.mutation_authority: Monitoring may not mutate canonical position state; Position Registry alone mutates canonical positions
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Monitoring owns monitoring observations and anomaly records; Position Registry owns canonical position state
boundaries.reconciliation_authority: Monitoring may initiate anomaly escalation; Position Registry performs canonical reconciliation disposition
boundaries.replay_authority: Monitoring replay reproduces observations; Position Registry replay reproduces canonical state

boundaries.constitutional_authority: determine and authorize exit intent according to Exit Decision doctrine
boundaries.correction_authority: Exit Decision corrects exit decision truth; Position Registry corrects canonical position state when admissible corrected exit evidence requires it
boundaries.dependency_direction: Position Registry depends on Exit Decision only for exit authorization truth; Exit Decision depends on Position Registry for current position state

determinations.authority_during_correction: originating office corrects exit truth; Position Registry corrects canonical lifecycle state only through admitted correction evidence
determinations.authority_during_replay: Position Registry replays canonical state from immutable accepted exit and mutation evidence
determinations.authority_following_exit_authorization: Position Registry validates authorization, performs or rejects lifecycle transition, and records evidence

boundaries.exit_authority: Exit Decision may authorize closure intent but does not execute canonical lifecycle transition
boundaries.interface_authority: Exit Decision produces exit authorization interface; Position Registry consumes and acknowledges disposition
boundaries.lifecycle_authority: Position Registry executes authorized lifecycle transitions and records lifecycle evidence
boundaries.mutation_authority: Exit Decision requests or authorizes; Position Registry accepts, rejects, and mutates canonical lifecycle state
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Exit Decision owns exit recommendations and exit authorization truth; Position Registry owns canonical position state
boundaries.reconciliation_authority: Position Registry reconciles canonical lifecycle effects; Exit Decision owns exit-decision corrections
boundaries.replay_authority: Position Registry replay re-applies authorized lifecycle transitions from immutable exit evidence

boundaries.constitutional_authority: own immutable historical position truth following constitutional transfer
boundaries.correction_authority: Closed Position Truth governs historical correction after transfer with immutable lineage preserved
boundaries.dependency_direction: Closed Position Truth -> Position Registry for transfer package; Position Registry relinquishes after accepted transfer
boundaries.mutation_authority: closed historical truth is immutable except explicit correction lineage
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Position Registry owns active state until transfer; Closed Position Truth owns immutable closed-position truth after transfer
boundaries.reconciliation_authority: Closed Position Truth reconciles immutable historical truth after transfer; Position Registry participates for transfer lineage only
boundaries.replay_authority: replay after transfer preserves historical truth and transfer record
boundaries.truth_transfer_authority: Position Registry initiates transfer after terminal closure prerequisites; Closed Position Truth acquires historical ownership

boundaries.constitutional_authority: own realized performance, performance metrics, historical analytics, and performance reporting
boundaries.dependency_direction: Performance Truth -> Closed Position Truth and Position Registry for source facts
boundaries.mutation_authority: Performance Truth may not mutate canonical or closed position truth
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Performance Truth owns performance analytics; Position Registry does not own performance analytics
boundaries.reconciliation_authority: Performance Truth reconciles performance calculations; source position truth remains owned by its constitutional owner
boundaries.replay_authority: performance replay reproduces analytics from immutable source facts

conflicts.deterministic_disposition: Exit Decision authorizes closure intent; Position Registry mutates lifecycle
ownership transfers only after terminal closure package acceptance

historical_transfer.completion_criteria: Closed Position Truth accepts immutable closed-position package and Position Registry records ownership relinquishment
historical_transfer.correction_behavior_after_transfer: Closed Position Truth governs historical correction with immutable lineage
historical_transfer.replay_behavior: replay preserves transfer record and does not reassign historical ownership

lifecycle_ownership.custodian: Position Registry and Monitoring observation custody

lifecycle_ownership.mutation_authority: Position Registry after Exit Decision authorization
